title: Regional Request Governor — probabilistic dispatch & soft-reservoir shedding
creator: Anika Shah
description: Implement a Regionally-aware Request Governor that blends latency-quantile scoring, probabilistic dispatch, and per-region soft-reservoirs (token buckets) to achieve SLOs while allowing graceful multi-region failover. The governor should: 1) prioritize low-latency local regions if capacity and SLO headroom permit, 2) probabilistically spill traffic to healthy remote regions based on latency/capacity signals to avoid correlated failures, and 3) perform controlled load shedding via configurable soft-reservoir thresholds and rollback-safe circuit breakers. This ticket scopes the design, infra changes, telemetry, and a staged rollout plan for Redwood Hosted and Dedicated modes.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and approved by Reliability and Serving Runtime teams
Implementation in request director supports probabilistic dispatch knob and per-region soft-reservoirs behind feature flag
End-to-end integration tests simulate regional capacity degradation and show graceful shift in traffic without SLO violations > 5 minutes
Canary rollout to 5% of production traffic with automatic rollback on SLO regression alerts
Dashboards (latency p50/p95/p99, success rate, per-region reservoir utilization, circuit breaker state) available in Console
Runbook updated with failover playbook and manual override endpoints
decisions: Use probabilistic dispatch rather than strict deterministic fallback to avoid thundering transfer and flatten sudden load spikes
Soft-reservoirs implemented as per-region token buckets with adjustable refill curves (linear + burst window)
Latency scoring uses weighted quantile score: primary weight on p95 and a smaller weight on recent p99 regressions to capture tail volatility
Circuit breaker tripping is hysteretic: requires sustained error-rate > threshold for 60s and partial traffic easing requires 3 consecutive 30s windows below threshold
Default SLO targets for routed API: availability 99.95% and p95 latency < 300ms for region-local routing path; proved in canary we may relax/adjust per-customer tiers

Implement probabilistic dispatcher in front of existing routing stack with feature flag
